scope: Concrete source-only observer predicate for Root technical decision; no native event reproduced and no observer broadening authorized by this note.

finding.title: Literal old16 public Title preflight necessarily disposes pristine validation Ray recipients outside the installed-donor allowlist
finding.predicate: _open_title enables _watch; _event marks every non-installed-donor callback forbidden. Shell whole prevalidation creates a fresh uncommitted L4 candidate then disposes it. Each pristine idle Ray emits a state_changed callback during native cleanup; these are not old installed donor IDs and cannot meet _retire_active.

source_chain.fact: Before each whole packet validation, dispose prior validation candidates; otherwise prepare fresh candidate from saved data and retain it in _validation_candidates[id]. Native Player/local/Shell prevalidation does not commit its saved HP/history.
Startup attempts.load_saved validates original/current/checkpoint, then disposes validation candidates and registration scope before Title.
Dispose calls exact candidate.level.exit_level, then its ownedcontainer.free, while candidate remains present in _validation_candidates during exit.

Fresh restore candidate binds own Hero/effects/Shell and sets _restore_candidate=true,_restore_candidate_ready=false. Exit sets _lifecycle_busy=true,_entered=false before cleanup; hero/effects/Shell and restore flags remain until cleanup returns. Public is_restore_candidate() is available; installed candidate finish clears the flag.
cleanup cancel_all(exchange_removed); pristine cycle0 idle records are not in terminal skip set, so cancel resets proof and calls _present with defaultnotifytrue, which emits state_changed(id,state).

smallest_precise_proposal.new_category: exact pristine uncommitted validation-recipient retirement, separate from installed old-donor retirement and installed new-recipient quietness
actual_identity_proof: Find ancestor CinderLevel of callback emitter; exact candidate.level and candidate.player pair must still appear in current Shell._validation_candidates values. Read only actual retained map, no dictionary manufactured by TEST.
Candidate level differs from Shell.active_level and candidate Hero differs from Shell.player; level.shared_shell==Shell; candidate.is_restore_candidate()==true and _restore_candidate_ready==false.
Tree paused; candidate._entered==false and _lifecycle_busy==true at callback; actual emitter is that candidate._exchange (canonical script) and actor id is one of original three Ray bindings.

Native state is pristine idle/clear,cycle0, empty reservation/exchange/proof/pending history and no HP progress; immutable selected constructor profile/map and source roots agree; freeze/read actual identities and retain full event.
smallest_precise_proposal.allowed_event_only: Corresponding exact Ray state_changed on disarmed never-installed pristine validation recipient; no action/damage/contact/defeat/input/progression/equipment/newinstalled events become allowed.
do_not: Do not allow any generic clear state or use level_id/path prefix as identity.
Do not relax installed-recipient quietness or native restore guards.
Keep all raw callbacks and separate provenance/disposition; report source predicate to Root before implementing a widened category.
